name: The Ritz-Carlton, Suzhou
positioning: Ritz-Carlton hotel in Suzhou's Gusu District with Suzhou-inspired room design and a Michelin Guide-selected Chinese restaurant
best_for: Travelers who want a base next to Suzhou's historic gardens and old streets
Food and wine lovers drawn to Huaiyang cuisine and rice wine experiences

facts.text: Guestroom design is inspired by the minimalist style of Suzhou architecture, with crisp black lines on white.
Gusu View rooms show lush greenery and garden architecture, while city view rooms show the urban energy of The China Central Place.
Biao Xia, the Chinese restaurant, is rooted in Huaiyang cuisine and blends seasonal seafood with carefully chosen ingredients.
Feng Pan Ting is a Chinese tea venue where guests enjoy Pingtan performance and traditional tea ceremonies with afternoon tea in a Jiangnan-inspired setting.
Alkanna Bar has a hidden wine cellar.
Alkanna is the international restaurant on the first floor.
Nearby sights include the Lingering Garden and Humble Administrator's Garden, both UNESCO sites, as well as Pingjiang Historic Street and Shantang Street.
The Ritz-Carlton Suite is on the 18th floor with panoramic views of the ancient cityscape and Suzhou's garden architecture.
The fitness centre is open 24 hours a day.
The Club Lounge on the 5th floor has an oriental-inspired outdoor garden setting.

highlights.text: Biao Xia is listed as a Michelin Guide restaurant selection for 2026.
A Private Cellar experience pairs seasonal bespoke dishes with Chinese wines in a hidden private wine cellar, with discreet sommelier service.
The Rice Wine Odyssey pairs Huaiyang cuisine with aged rice wine, with handcrafted rice wine welcome drinks and DIY rice wine cocktails.
A private night tour of the Humble Administrator's Garden is offered to guests.
An experience explores the H+ Art Museum, designed by Tadao Ando and within walking distance, with private guided tours.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide airport shuttle service.
Club access requires an upgraded booking; Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access.
Breakfast at Alkanna is available for a fee.
